acceptance: A TDD predicate file with a narrative comment is corrected at TDD exit (red first)
The build floor ignores the cycle's TDD-owned predicate files, and a cycle whose only comments are TDD's passes the build floor
fix: Run commentFloorResult at TDD exit over the files TDD wrote, so TDD corrects its own comments, and exclude those files from the build floor's scan. Flipping comment_floor.stage to enforce stays with comment-floor-enforce.
routed_reason: split of tdd-comment-floor-then-enforce: the files that are not protected
source: console, 2026-09-30, comment round 12 editors and reviewers (PR #749)
summary: The build handoff floor counts every comment the cycle's diff adds, including go/acs/cycle<N>/predicates_test.go, which the TDD phase writes and the builder may not edit (builder profile, persona). Enforcing it now would send the builder a correction it can never make; 10 of the last 15 cycles' predicate files hold counted comments. So comment_floor stays shadow (architecture review of the no-comment policy, 2026-09-30).
title: Give the TDD phase its own comment floor and keep its predicate files out of the build floor's scan, so comment_floor can be enforced (lane part)
